result.brief: 提出 D-Scope 框架，用稀疏自编码器将 DiT 特征解释与生成控制相连，通过视觉证据检索特征并干预解码方向，实现可控生成。
result.reason: SAE-based interpretation and steering of diffusion transformers directly serves controllable video/image generation representations; abstract shows feature retrieval and decoder-direction interventions for generation control.
